title: National symbols: flags, anthems and heroes
goal: Read how flags, anthems and statues were made in the new republics, and use the passive with se to say what was created and when.

items: Use the passive with *se* (*se crearon himnos*) to say what was created and when.
Say who created the Argentine flag and when the Argentine anthem was approved.
Say when the Mexican anthem was sung for the first time.
Say why new symbols seem old.
Use the key words of this lesson: flag, anthem, hero, coat of arms, symbol, monument, creation and to invent.
